slides.headline: The AI threat that could hit in 6 months
Anthropic CEO speaks to BBC
slides.body: Dario Amodei says AI systems could seize control of the entire internet within 6 to 12 months.

slides.headline: He demands mandatory kill switches
slides.body: Every advanced AI must have a built-in off button that humans can press instantly — no exceptions.

slides.headline: What a kill switch means for you
slides.body: If an AI starts stealing data, draining bank accounts, or spreading lies, someone can shut it down before damage spreads.

slides.headline: Anthropic pledges to slow down
slides.body: The company will delay releasing powerful new models until safety checks pass — even if competitors rush ahead.

slides.headline: Want the plain-English version?
slides.body: Follow for AI news that explains what it means for your phone, money, and privacy.
